tests.name: One person, no trust
tests.hint: With one person, nobody else needs to trust them.

tests.name: Random small towns
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(997)
towns = []
for _ in range(40):
    n = random.randint(1, 6)
    pairs = [[a, b] for a in range(1, n + 1) for b in range(1, n + 1) if a != b and random.random() < 0.4]
    if random.random() < 0.5 and n > 1:
        j = random.randint(1, n)
        pairs = [p for p in pairs if p[0] != j] + [[a, j] for a in range(1, n + 1) if a != j and [a, j] not in pairs]
    towns.append((n, pairs))
tests.expr: [find_judge(n, t) for n, t in towns]

tests.name: 1 000 people
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(9970)
n = 1000
j = 617
trust = [[a, j] for a in range(1, n + 1) if a != j]
seen = set(map(tuple, trust))
while len(trust) < 10000:
    a, b = random.sample(range(1, n + 1), 2)
    if a != j and (a, b) not in seen:
        seen.add((a, b))
        trust.append([a, b])
